# Design Document ## Overview Clipboard and duplicate are built from three pieces: 1. **A shape codec for the clipboard** in `formats/`: a small JSON envelope around the existing `.p2s` shape encoders and decoders, plus an SVG writer for a list of shapes. Formats stay Qt-free and unaware of the session. 2. **Operations** in `editing/operations/clipboard.py`: copy and cut return plain clipboard content, paste takes it, and duplicate is a registered operation. One helper hands out fresh ids to copied shapes, including Composite parts. Everything goes through `editing/containers.py`, so it works the same on layers and inside an entered Composite. 3. **Qt glue** in `views/`: a thin `views/clipboard.py` turns content into `QMimeData` and back, and `MainWindow` runs Cut/Copy/Paste/Paste in Place as window commands, because they need the system clipboard (and Paste the view center). Alt+drag to duplicate is a variant of the Select tool's move gesture. The preview draws the moved copies on top through the gesture matrix and leaves the originals and the recorded document picture untouched; release commits through one operation. ## Steering Document Alignment ### Technical Standards (tech.md) - **State:** operations change `AppState` inside `session.edit(label)`; views never touch state. The clipboard is not app state: it lives in the system clipboard and only views talk to it. - **No Qt below `views/`:** the codec and operations work with `bytes` / `str`, so everything except the `QMimeData` mapping is unit-tested headless. - **Layer rules:** `formats/clipboard.py` uses models and geometry only, as `p2s.py` does. Bounds that need text outlines are computed in `editing` (which may use `render`) and passed into the SVG writer. - **Frozen shapes:** copies are made with `dataclasses.replace`; ids are the only thing that changes when a shape is copied. - **Security:** clipboard input is treated like an opened file: size limits, validated decoders, the same SVG reader. ### Project Structure (structure.md) - New: `formats/clipboard.py`, `editing/operations/clipboard.py`, `views/clipboard.py`. - Changed: `formats/svg.py` (shape-list writer), `editing/operations/_document.py` (fresh ids, insertion helper), `tools/select.py` (Alt+drag), `tools/base.py` (`CursorType.DUPLICATE`), `render/overlay.py` + `render/picture.py` (copy preview), `views/keymap.py`, `views/main_window.py`, `views/actions.py`, `views/cursors.py`. - Tests mirror the layout: `tests/formats/test_clipboard.py`, `tests/editing/test_clipboard.py`, `tests/tools/test_select.py` (Alt+drag), `tests/render/test_picture.py` (copy preview). ## Code Reuse Analysis ### Existing Components to Leverage - **`formats.p2s.encode_shape` / `decode_shape`:** the clipboard's native payload is a list of encoded shapes, so every shape type the native format knows is copyable, with the same validation and limits. - **`formats.p2s_migrations.CURRENT_VERSION`:** stamped into the clipboard envelope. A different version (another PressToShape build) falls back to the SVG flavor, which is always present. - **`formats.svg._shape_element`, `read_svg_with_notes`:** SVG out and in. Composites already carry their parts in SVG metadata, so even the SVG flavor round-trips Composites between PressToShape instances. - **`editing.containers.change_container`, `edited_composite`, `with_parts`:** inserting pasted and duplicated shapes into a layer or an entered Composite, with part modes. - **`editing.operations._document.new_id`, `remove_shapes`, `prune_selection`:** ids, Cut's removal, selection cleanup. - **`editing.operations.selection.delete_selection`:** Cut reuses its body (including closing an emptied Composite), factored into a helper that takes the undo label. - **`editing.operations.paths._to_path`:** text pasted into an entered Composite becomes a path, since text can't be a part. - **`geometry.transforms.translate`:** placing pasted shapes and committing Alt+drag. - **`render.paths.PathCache.geometry_bounds`:** bounds of pasted shapes (text included) for centering and for the SVG `viewBox`. - **`tools.select.SelectTool` MOVE mode, `render.overlay.Overlay.matrix`:** Alt+drag reuses the move gesture and matrix preview. - **`views.keymap` / `views.actions`:** bindings, menus and actions as for every other command. ### Integration Points - **System clipboard (`QGuiApplication.clipboard()`):** written on Copy/Cut, read on Paste, watched through `dataChanged` to enable Paste. - **`CanvasView.view_center()`:** where Paste centers the shapes. - **Undo history:** Cut, Paste, Paste in Place and Duplicate are each one `session.edit` step. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph TD K[keymap: Ctrl+C/X/V, Ctrl+Shift+V, Ctrl+D] --> A[AppActions] A -->|window commands| MW[MainWindow.copy/cut/paste/paste_in_place] A -->|registered op| DUP[operations.clipboard.duplicate_selection] MW --> VC[views/clipboard.py
ClipboardContent <-> QMimeData] VC --> QC[(system clipboard)] MW --> OPS[operations/clipboard.py
copy_selection, cut_selection, paste] ST[tools/select.py Alt+drag] --> DM[operations.clipboard.duplicate_and_move] OPS --> FC[formats/clipboard.py
encode_shapes, decode_shapes] OPS --> SVG[formats/svg.py
write_shapes_svg, read_svg_with_notes] FC --> P2S[formats/p2s.py encode/decode_shape] OPS --> D[_document.py
with_fresh_ids, insert_above] DUP --> D DM --> D D --> C[containers.change_container] ``` ## Components and Interfaces ### `formats/clipboard.py` (new) - **Purpose:** the native clipboard payload: a versioned JSON list of shapes. - **Interfaces:** ```python MIME_TYPE = "application/x-presstoshape-shapes" def encode_shapes(shapes: Sequence[Shape]) -> bytes # {"format": "presstoshape-shapes", "version": CURRENT_VERSION, "shapes": [encode_shape(...), ...]}, UTF-8 def decode_shapes(data: bytes) -> list[Shape] # Raises ClipboardError (a P2sError) on: over the size limit, bad JSON, wrong format marker, # other version, empty list, any shape decode error. Ids are kept as stored; callers renumber. ``` - **Dependencies:** `formats.p2s` (codecs, readers, limits), `formats.p2s_migrations.CURRENT_VERSION`. - **Reuses:** the `.p2s` JSON reading rules (no NaN/Infinity constants, size limit equal to the document limit). - Not migrated: the clipboard is short-lived, so a version mismatch is not an error for the user; paste just uses the SVG flavor. ### `formats/svg.py` (extended) - **New interface:** ```python def write_shapes_svg(shapes: Sequence[Shape], bounds: Rect) -> str # A standalone SVG whose viewBox is `bounds` (doc coordinates), width/height = bounds size, # shapes written exactly as write_svg writes them (no layer group). ``` - `write_svg` and the new function share `_shape_element`. Keeping doc coordinates in the `viewBox` (instead of moving the shapes to 0,0) means Paste in Place of that SVG lands where the shapes were copied from (Req 4.2), and other apps still see a tight drawing. - Reading clipboard SVG uses the existing `read_svg_with_notes`: shapes of all layers are flattened in document order by the paste operation. ### `editing/operations/_document.py` (extended) - **New interfaces:** ```python def with_fresh_ids(state: AppState, shapes: Sequence[Shape]) -> list[Shape] # Same shapes, each (and every Composite part, recursively) with a new id from new_id(). def insert_above(state: AppState, new_shapes: Sequence[Shape], anchor_ids: set[int] | None, modes: Mapping[int, PartMode] | None = None) -> None # Inserts into the active container: directly above the topmost shape in `anchor_ids`, or on top when # None. Outside edit mode with anchor None the target is the active layer, hidden or not. ``` - One place renumbers ids, so groups and symbols can reuse it later. ### `editing/operations/clipboard.py` (new) - **Purpose:** the clipboard and duplicate operations. - **Interfaces:** ```python @dataclass(frozen=True) class ClipboardContent: native: bytes # formats.clipboard payload svg: str # write_shapes_svg def copy_selection(session) -> ClipboardContent | None # None when nothing is selected. Status "Copied N object(s)"; notify; no edit, not dirty. def cut_selection(session) -> ClipboardContent | None # copy_selection + delete in one edit "Cut". def paste(session, native: bytes | None, svg: str | None, center: Point | None) -> bool # center=None: Paste in Place (label "Paste in Place"); else move the shapes' bounds center to `center` # (label "Paste"). Tries native first, then svg; False + status "Nothing to paste" if neither decodes. @operation("edit.duplicate", "D&uplicate", can_run=has selection) def duplicate_selection(session) -> None # edit "Duplicate": copies of the selection above the topmost selected shape, selected. Clipboard untouched. def duplicate_and_move(session, dx: float, dy: float) -> None # Alt+drag commit: duplicate + translate copies in one edit "Duplicate". ``` - **Selected shapes:** `queries.selected_shapes` in paint order (bottom to top) — under the Node tool too, so Copy takes whole shapes (Req 1.6). - **Paste flow:** 1. Decode: `decode_shapes(native)`; on `P2sError` or no native, `read_svg_with_notes(svg)` with all layers' shapes in order. Parse failures are caught here (external boundary) and end in "Nothing to paste". 2. If an entered Composite is the target: text shapes become paths (`_to_path`), noted in the status. 3. Place: with a center, translate all shapes by `center - bounds_center`, where bounds come from a throwaway `PathCache` (`geometry_bounds`, union over the shapes). 4. `with session.edit(label)`: `with_fresh_ids`, `insert_above(..., anchor_ids=None)`, selection = new top-level ids, node selection cleared, status "Pasted N object(s)" plus "(layer 'X' is hidden)" / SVG notes. - **Duplicate flow:** in one edit, for the selection in paint order, `with_fresh_ids`, `insert_above(copies, anchor_ids=selection, modes=same modes as originals)`; selection = copies. Inside a Composite the copies keep their originals' part modes (Req 5.6). - **Copy SVG bounds:** union of `geometry_bounds` of the copied shapes; a zero-size union (e.g. a single horizontal line) is padded to 1 unit so the `viewBox` stays valid. ### `editing/operations/selection.py` (refactor) - `delete_selection`'s shape-removal body moves to `_delete_selected(state, label)` so Cut uses the same rules (including removing a Composite whose last part was cut and closing its edit mode). ### `tools/select.py` (extended) - **Alt+drag:** in `press`, when the press starts a MOVE and `mods.alt` is held, the tool sets `self._duplicating = True`. Selection rules on press stay as without Alt (Req 6.1). Alt on handles is checked first, so it keeps meaning "scale from center" (Req 6.5). - `move` is unchanged (same translation matrix). Shift behaves as for a plain move: today a move has no Shift constraint, so neither does Alt+drag; an axis constraint for both would be a separate change. - `release`: if duplicating and the translation is non-zero, call `clipboard.duplicate_and_move(session, dx, dy)`; a zero translation (press and release on the same point) does nothing (Req 6.4). - Cursor: `CursorType.DUPLICATE` while duplicating. - `overlay`: while duplicating, `Overlay(selection, copies=tuple(moving shapes), matrix=..., frame=frame.transformed(matrix))` with `moving` empty, so the document picture stays as recorded and the originals stay visible. ### `render/overlay.py` + `render/picture.py` (extended) - `Overlay.copies: tuple[Shape, ...] = ()` — shapes to draw again through `matrix` on top of the document. - `DocumentPicture.draw_copies(canvas, copies, matrix)` records the copies into one `skia.Picture` keyed by the `copies` tuple (recorded once per gesture) and draws it under `matrix`. `CanvasView._paint` calls it after the document picture. Cost per frame stays one `drawPicture`, as for a normal move. ### `tools/base.py`, `views/cursors.py` - `CursorType.DUPLICATE`, mapped to `Qt.CursorShape.DragCopyCursor`. ### `views/clipboard.py` (new) - **Purpose:** the only code that touches `QClipboard` / `QMimeData`. - **Interfaces:** ```python SVG_TYPES = ("image/svg+xml", "image/x-inkscape-svg") def put(content: ClipboardContent) -> None # native under formats.clipboard.MIME_TYPE, SVG under both SVG_TYPES, and the SVG as text/plain # (text editors; Inkscape does the same). def read() -> tuple[bytes | None, str | None] # (native, svg). svg comes from an SVG type, else from text/plain if it looks like an SVG document # (starts with " bool # Checks offered formats only (native, SVG types, or text), never parses (Req NFR performance). ``` ### `views/keymap.py`, `views/actions.py`, `views/main_window.py` - `WINDOW_COMMANDS` gains `edit.cut` ("Cu&t"), `edit.copy` ("&Copy"), `edit.paste` ("&Paste"), `edit.paste_in_place` ("Paste in Pl&ace"). - `KEYMAP`: `edit.cut` → `Keys.Cut`, `edit.copy` → `Keys.Copy`, `edit.paste` → `Keys.Paste` (standard keys expand to Ctrl+X/Shift+Del, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+Ins, Ctrl+V/Shift+Ins per platform), `edit.paste_in_place` → `"Ctrl+Shift+V"`, `edit.duplicate` → `"Ctrl+D"`. - Edit menu: `edit.undo, edit.redo, None, edit.cut, edit.copy, edit.paste, edit.paste_in_place, edit.duplicate, edit.delete, None, edit.select_all`. No toolbar icons (Req 7.4: the main toolbar has no room that fits). - `AppActions` gains `set_enabled(command_id, enabled)` for window commands. `MainWindow.refresh` enables Cut/Copy from `state.selection`, Paste/Paste in Place from `clipboard.can_paste()`; `QClipboard.dataChanged` re-runs that check (disconnected in `closeEvent`, per the lifetime rule). - `MainWindow.copy/cut` call the operation and `clipboard.put` the result; `paste` / `paste_in_place` call `clipboard.read()` and `clipboard_ops.paste(session, native, svg, center)` with `center = self.canvas.view_center()` for Paste and `None` for Paste in Place. - **Text fields keep their shortcuts (Req 7.3):** `QLineEdit` / spin boxes accept `ShortcutOverride` for the standard copy/cut/paste keys, so window-level actions don't fire while they have focus. Ctrl+D and Ctrl+Shift+V are not overridden by line edits; Ctrl+D is harmless there (selection-based), and Ctrl+Shift+V pasting shapes while a field has focus is accepted. Checked in the interaction test. ## Data Models ### Clipboard payload (`application/x-presstoshape-shapes`) ```json { "format": "presstoshape-shapes", "version": 1, "shapes": [ { "type": "rect", "id": 7, "x": 10, "...": "same objects as in .p2s document layers" } ] } ``` - `version` is `p2s_migrations.CURRENT_VERSION`; only an exact match is decoded. - Shapes are listed bottom to top. Ids are the source ids and are replaced on paste. - Not a file format: it is not documented in `docs/file-format.md` and needs no migrations or samples. ### `Overlay` addition ```python copies: tuple[Shape, ...] = () # drawn again through `matrix`, on top; originals stay in place ``` ## Error Handling ### Error Scenarios 1. **Clipboard has no pasteable data** (empty, image only, plain text that isn't SVG). - **Handling:** `read()` returns `(None, None)`; `paste` returns False. - **User Impact:** status "Nothing to paste"; document unchanged, no undo step. 2. **Broken or hostile native payload** (bad JSON, unknown type, huge numbers, oversized). - **Handling:** `decode_shapes` raises `ClipboardError`; paste falls back to the SVG flavor, then to scenario 1. - **User Impact:** paste still works from SVG when possible; otherwise "Nothing to paste". 3. **Broken SVG** (malformed XML, not an `
